description: CloneInstancePayload and RestoreInstancePayload both require a body property `instanceId` that shares its name with the `{instanceId}` path parameter, so conversion keeps only the path label and callers cannot send the required body field. The two ids differ: STACKIT's CLI (stackitcloud/stackit-cli, internal/cmd/mongodbflex/backup/restore/restore.go, read 2026-11-01) puts the instance holding the backup in the path and sends the target instance in the body (`--backup-instance-id`, 'Instance ID of the target instance to restore the backup to', defaulting to the path's instance). Add the body field as `targetInstanceId`, on the wire as `instanceId`, required as the spec has it. No live probe.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Instance the clone is applied to, in the request body. The path's `instanceId` is the instance holding the backups. Use the same id to apply it to that instance.
Instance the backup is restored to, in the request body. The path's `instanceId` is the instance holding the backup. Use the same id to restore it in place.
